description: Decide whether an L2 is suitable for sending a transaction: PASS or FAIL with a reason code for the chosen chain, from Phoenix Zero measurements (each chain polled every ~2 s against 2-3 independent RPC nodes, Casper 10; feed records signed BLAKE3+Ed25519, responses signed EIP-191). The free answer is delayed ~60 s and checks chain halt, sequencer stall and latency only: it does not include revert ratio, so it never returns DEGRADED. The live verdict with revert ratio (Base/Arbitrum) and p99 latency is paid via x402 from $0.01 USDC (the 402 offers USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum).

chain.description: L2 chain to check. Defaults to base.

metric.description: health_check = free delayed PASS/FAIL (no revert ratio). latency / revert_ratio = live values via paid x402 endpoints. revert_ratio: Base and Arbitrum only.

name: preflight_network_health
